original: ब्रह्मणः पुत्र आसीद्वै मरीचिर्भगवानृषिः । कश्यपस्तत्सुतो जातो यस्माद्विश्वाः प्रजा इमाः ॥

translation: The son of Brahma was the divine sage Marichi; from him sprang Kashyapa, from whom all creatures of the universe descended.
meaning: Chaturtha Amsa — Royal Dynasties & Lineage of Sri Rama (Verse 4.1): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

translation: In the Solar Dynasty was born King Ikshvaku, in whose royal lineage arose monarchs profoundly learned in cosmic righteousness.
meaning: Chaturtha Amsa — Royal Dynasties & Lineage of Sri Rama (Verse 4.2): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

original: तत्र जातो रघुर्धीमान् दिलीपतनयो बली । यस्य नाम्ना बभूवासौ रघुवंशः सुविश्रुतः ॥

translation: Therein was born the wise and mighty Raghu, son of Dilipa, by whose name the renowned Raghuvaṁśa dynasty was glorified.

translation: From that lineage came King Dasharatha, unto whom Lord Hari took birth fourfold as his sons for the protection of all the worlds.

original: रामो दाशरथिर्वीरो धर्मो विग्रहवांस्तथा । लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा सीतायाश्च पतिः प्रभुः ॥
transliteration: rāmo dāśarathirvīro dharmo vigrahavāṃstathā | lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā sītāyāśca patiḥ prabhuḥ ||
translation: Rama, son of Dasharatha, the embodiment of Dharma in human form, walked this earth with his brother Lakshmana and his consort Sita.

original: जघान रावणं संख्ये पौलस्त्यं लोककण्टकम् । संस्थाप्य धर्मममलं रामराज्यमकारयत् ॥
transliteration: jaghāna rāvaṇaṃ saṃkhye paulastyaṃ lokakaṇṭakam | saṃsthāpya dharmamamalaṃ rāmarājyamakārayat ||
translation: He slew Ravana, the oppressor of the worlds, in righteous battle, and established the stainless golden age of Ramarajya.
meaning: Chaturtha Amsa — Royal Dynasties & Lineage of Sri Rama (Verse 4.6): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 4, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

original: सोमवंशे समुत्पन्नः पुरूरवा महामतिः । ययातिश्च नहुषश्च यदुश्चैव महायशाः ॥
transliteration: somavaṃśe samutpannaḥ purūravā mahāmatiḥ | yayātiśca nahuṣaśca yaduścaiva mahāyaśāḥ ||
translation: In the Lunar Dynasty arose wise Pururavas, Nahusha, Yayati, and the illustrious Yadu, founder of the Yadavas.
meaning: Chaturtha Amsa — Royal Dynasties & Lineage of Sri Rama (Verse 4.7): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 4, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

original: यदोर्वंशे समुद्भूता यादवा बलशालिनः । यत्रावतीर्णो भगवान् वासुदेवः पुरातनः ॥
transliteration: yadorvaṃśe samudbhūtā yādavā balaśālinaḥ | yatrāvatīrṇo bhagavān vāsudevaḥ purātanaḥ ||
translation: In Yadu's dynasty arose the mighty Yadavas, wherein the primordial Supreme Lord Vasudeva manifested to relieve the earth.
meaning: Chaturtha Amsa — Royal Dynasties & Lineage of Sri Rama (Verse 4.8): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

original: कुरुवंशे समुत्पन्नाः पाण्डवा धर्मचारिणः । युधिष्ठिरमुखा वीराः सत्यव्रतपरायणाः ॥
transliteration: kuruvaṃśe samutpannāḥ pāṇḍavā dharmacāriṇaḥ | yudhiṣṭhiramukhā vīrāḥ satyavrataparāyaṇāḥ ||
translation: In the Kuru dynasty arose the righteous Pandavas, headed by King Yudhishthira, ever dedicated to the vow of truth.
meaning: Chaturtha Amsa — Royal Dynasties & Lineage of Sri Rama (Verse 4.9): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

original: एते चान्ये च बहवो राजानः पृथिवीक्षितः । कालेन कवलीभूताः कीर्तिरेषां स्थिरा भुवि ॥
transliteration: ete cānye ca bahavo rājānaḥ pṛthivīkṣitaḥ | kālena kavalībhūtāḥ kīrtireṣāṃ sthirā bhuvi ||
translation: These and countless other kings who ruled the earth have all been swallowed by time; their memory alone remains to remind humanity of impermanence.
